quests_main:quest-013.summary: During "The Broken Slate", Jiahto translates the ancient Slate for Link, which reveals that the Sky can be accessed by shooting the "mark of the king" through a "droplet" on the "land of the sky fish". After both "Tulin of Rito Village" and "Yunobo of Goron City" have been completed, she suggests visiting Zora's Domain next, since Monsters are more active in the south.

quests_side:quest-135.summary: When Link prays to the Spring of Wisdom Statue at the Spring of Wisdom, she expresses her concern that she can no longer sense the presence of the Mother Goddess Statue, who is situated within a "vast canyon". It is possible to witness her actions by climbing up the silo and entering through the window on the second floor. Ascending into the silo does not trigger quest progression but will instead result in being removed from the silo.

quests_adventure:quest-011.summary: The Side Adventure begins after speaking to Cece at Ventest Clothing Boutique. Reede barges into the Armor Shop to confront Cece for her part in redeveloping Hateno Village and its new image as a fashion center for Hyrule.
